dedupe_keys.name: finite element endpoint dataset for sdcm geogrid reinforced high speed railway embankments under hydro climatic scenarios

description: Finite-element endpoint dataset for SDCM–geogrid-reinforced high-speed railway embankments under hydro-climatic scenarios is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Hoang Nam Phan, Pham Van Ngoc. This dataset contains 810 records of hydro-mechanical endpoint responses for high-speed railway embankments reinforced with stiffened deep cement mixing (SDCM) columns and a geogrid. The records are reported outputs from a PLAXIS 2D finite-element campaign and cover 162 configurations, each evaluated under five prescribed hydro-climatic states (C0–C4). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
